messages:
Alex: Quick heads up — I need to push a docs + version bump to 1.6.0. Cutoff is 22:00 UTC today; can we get a late exception for a docs-only changelog addition? PR #5123
Maya: Is it just the changelog and a pkg.json version bump? If it's docs-only we usually allow it until cutoff -30m. who owns the changelog entry? pinging @Sam for oncall signoff.
Ryan: I skimmed the diff. looks trivial, but CI showed a mdx lint on the first run. should be fixable.
Sam: Oncall here — I can sign off if CI is green in the next 15m. If it fails we push to the next window. @Alex can you rebase onto release/v1.6.0?
Alex: rebase done, addressed the md lint. removed an extra newline in CHANGELOG.md and bumped package.json version field. CI retriggered.
ci-bot: ✅ CI passed — unit, lint, and e2e all green for PR #5123.
Maya: tagging @release-crew — can someone merge when you're free? This should go to staging then canary.
deploy-bot: :rocket: Merged by Maya via web UI. Release pipeline started: release/v1.6.0 -> staging. Estimated deploy ~5m.
Alex: thanks! added a short rollback note to the changelog (how-to: revert tag `release/v1.6.0` + force redeploy).
Ryan: :thumbsup: no further concerns from me.
Sam: I'll watch the canary rollout and signal if anything odd. If health checks fail we run rollback plan.
Alex: closing the loop — merged and canary healthy at +10m. No rollback required. Thanks everyone!
